question: Will Kaiser Permanente and the California Nurses Association reach a tentative agreement on a new Northern California contract before October 30, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo is no TA: as of Kaiser's Oct 12 update, 17 sessions since July with no TA, next sessions Oct 21-22 and Kaiser scheduling dates through December. Relations are contentious (Kaiser open letter Oct 8; CNA running a strike authorization vote; no 10-day strike notice received). Reference class: the 2022 NorCal Kaiser-CNA round took ~5.5 months (June to Nov 18), with the TA arriving days before a noticed strike. With no strike deadline before Oct 30 and only ~4 possible bargaining days left, a TA in the next 10 days is unlikely. Upside: Kaiser says its offer has no economic takeaways, and other recent Kaiser disputes settled. No prediction market found (harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi/bookmakers not searched).
